description: Implementation of the LoanApplicationWritePlatformService using JPA repository for handling loan applications, including methods for submitting, modifying, deleting, approving, and rejecting loans, along with related calendar and account association management.

classes.name: LoanApplicationWritePlatformServiceJpaRepositoryImpl
classes.description: Implementation class for managing loan applications, including creation, modification, approval, rejection, and deletion, utilizing JPA repositories and handling associated calendar and account linkages.

methods.name: submitApplication
methods.description: Handles submission of a new loan application, performing validation, assembling loan object, saving related entities, and triggering business events.

methods.name: modifyApplication
methods.description: Updates an existing loan application with new data, including calendar adjustments and linked account modifications; validates and persists changes.

methods.name: deleteApplication
methods.description: Deletes a loan application, removing notes, linked accounts, and collateral managements, after validating state and permissions.

methods.name: approveGLIMLoanAppication
methods.description: Approves a group loan with individual monitoring accounts (GLIM), processing approvals for child loans and updating parent account status accordingly.

methods.name: approveApplication
methods.description: Approves a loan application, creating approval schedules, notes, and notifying relevant business events.

methods.name: undoGLIMLoanApplicationApproval
methods.description: Reverts approval of a GLIM loan and its child loans, updating parent account status.

methods.name: undoApplicationApproval
methods.description: Undoes approval of a specific loan, regenerating schedules, removing approvals, and notifying events.

methods.name: rejectGLIMApplicationApproval
methods.description: Rejects a GLIM loan and its associated child loans, updating statuses accordingly.

methods.name: rejectApplication
methods.description: Rejects a specific loan application, updating its state and recording notes.

methods.name: applicantWithdrawsFromApplication
methods.description: Processes an applicant withdrawing their loan application, releasing collaterals and updating status.
